project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-143 Rev 2 (Auto as Full Platform Operator + Observability Lock)
description: PRD-143 Rev 2 (2026-06-09): the security model is INVERTED vs the old draft. Auto gets the FULL operator surface — every platform API exposed as a tool, including platform-administrative capabilities — at autonomy=full, protected by gates-and-logs (PRD-140 hierarchy checks, destructive backstop, audit, HARNESS rollback, human kill-switch), NOT by exclusion. The ONLY hard-excluded tier is OBSERVABILITY + the oversight control plane, locked to system_role=='super_admin' (Gerard, the sole super admin), fail-closed, independent of the autonomy dial: the 6 obs tools + platform_set_autonomy_level + the obs/analytics HTTP routers. Also: tool-scaffolding mechanism toward ~200 tools, telemetry-seeded graph routing, selection robustness at scale, one fully-autonomous concierge journey. Builds ON PRD-142 Wave 4 / PRD-138/139 / PRD-140 — extends, never rebuilds. Full context: docs/PRDS/PRD-143-AUTO-FULL-PLATFORM-OPERATOR.md.

userStories.title: Executor: super-admin gate that the full-autonomy bypass CANNOT cross
userStories.description: As the Super admin, I want PlatformActionExecutor to refuse super_admin_only actions pre-execution for any principal that is not literally system_role=='super_admin', so neither Auto at autonomy=full nor an admin API key can invoke obs tools.
acceptanceCriteria: In orchestrator/modules/tools/discovery/platform_executor.py execute path (:477-523): add the super_admin_only gate BEFORE and INDEPENDENT of the existing admin_only gate. The check: action_def.super_admin_only and (caller_context or {}).get('system_role') != 'super_admin' → refuse pre-execution with a permission_denied result mirroring the admin-gate shape (:506-540).

CRITICAL — three verified traps the gate must NOT fall into: (1) the full_autonomy → is_admin=True bypass at :510 applies ONLY to admin_only, NEVER to super_admin_only; (2) the _workspace_has_admin_owner() fallback at :522 must NOT satisfy the su gate; (3) caller_context=None (heartbeat/agent-factory paths) → REFUSE su actions (fail-closed), do not resolve from workspace owner.
API-key principals carry system_role='admin' (core/auth/hybrid.py:783) and MUST be refused.
A genuine super-admin principal (caller_context={'system_role': 'super_admin'}) executes the action normally — including via Auto when Gerard is the driving chat principal.

userStories.title: Auth: one canonical require_super_admin FastAPI dependency
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single reusable dependency that 403s everyone except system_role=='super_admin', so obs routers lock consistently with zero ad-hoc copies.
acceptanceCriteria: NEW small module orchestrator/core/auth/super_admin.py (do NOT modify core/auth/hybrid.py — it is the 657-call-site shared auth; PRD-09 precedent says extend via narrow new deps, never touch the shared path): `async def require_super_admin(ctx: RequestContext = Depends(get_request_context_hybrid)) -> RequestContext` — raises HTTPException(403, 'Super admin only') unless ctx.user is present AND ctx.user.system_role == 'super_admin'; returns ctx otherwise. Fail-closed on missing user/system_role.
API-key contexts (system_role='admin' per hybrid.py:783) → 403. SDK/service contexts (system_role='service', hybrid.py:616) → 403. Workspace owner/admin without the system role → 403.
No os.getenv; no config reads; pure role check.

userStories.title: Tool scaffolder: router endpoint → 3-file skeleton (scaffold-then-curate, never auto-register)
